visualCharacteristics: Two (fixed, non-wrapping) download panels side by side on light-grey: H2, bold subheadline, body copy with inline link, outlined black button with download icon. Keeps columns content model (one row, one cell per panel).
contentPattern: One row, one cell per column; additional rows must keep the same cell count. Each cell: H2 heading, subheadline paragraph, description with optional inline link, and a standalone link paragraph that becomes the download button.

structure.note: One row, one cell per column; additional rows must keep the same cell count.

usage.description: Side-by-side download panels, each with a heading, subheadline, description and a download button.

reuseGuidance: Use for two or three parallel download or call-to-action panels (e.g. Windows vs Linux). Put the download link in its own paragraph so it renders as the button. Use columns for image/text layouts and columns-link-panels for link lists.
